title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend - Workflows & Policies *EU/UK remote* (m/f/d)
description:
ABOUT US

Pliant is a modular B2B payments platform that combines commercial card issuing, payment accounts, FX, and spend management in one system, adapting to existing setups rather than requiring customers to replace them.

Businesses across industries such as travel, e-commerce, and insurance use Pliant to manage complex payment workflows with cards, backed by credit lines Pliant underwrites itself.

Fintechs and software platforms embed Pliant’s payment infrastructure into their own products, from API-based Cards-as-a-Service to fully white-label solutions. Banks use Pliant’s Card & Spend OS, the customer-facing interface, on their own infrastructure to run card programs.

Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Berlin, Pliant serves 5,000+ businesses and 40+ partners across Europe and the United States. A principal member of Visa and Mastercard, Pliant issues commercial cards in 13 currencies across 32 countries, under its own European e-money license and with licensed partners in the UK and US.


Learn more at www.getpliant.com http://www.getpliant.com


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Backend, Workflows & Policies (m/f/d) to join one of our cross-functional teams of frontend and backend engineers, product managers, and designers. The team builds and maintains the solutions that put customers in control of their company spending: configurable approval policies for card requests and bank transfers, AI-assisted transaction review, and automated reimbursement of personal spend by employees, all supported by task-driven workflows across the Pliant platform. This is high-impact, high-scale engineering at the core of a fast-growing fintech, where precision, resilience, and smart execution directly shape how money moves for thousands of organisations.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Conceptualise, define, and develop our banking platform.

 - Ensure a scalable, maintainable, and secure microservice architecture.

 - Design and evolve RESTful APIs that power both our own products and partner integrations.

 - Contribute to architectural decisions and technical RFCs across the engineering group.

 - Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and frontend engineers in a cross-functional team.

 - Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve the performance and reliability of production services.

 - Implement unit, integration, and E2E tests.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 5+ years of relevant experience with Java and Spring Boot.

 - Expertise in building testable, maintainable, and extendable architecture, with care for engineering craft and the trade-offs behind technical decisions.

 - Knowledge of distributed architecture patterns and antipatterns.

 - Proficiency with REST APIs and solid working knowledge of relational databases (we use PostgreSQL).

 - Experience with agentic programming.

 - Experience with AWS and Docker.

 - Bonus: experience with Terraform.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - The opportunity to work in a growing team with big responsibilities that thrives on a strong exchange of knowledge and excellence

 - Attractive remuneration

 - Your choice of preferred OS, Windows or Mac

 - Flat hierarchy and transparent communication in a relaxed, professional atmosphere

 - Opportunity to develop your talent in a dynamic team with ambitious goals

 - Flexibility and possibility to work remotely

 - Monthly mobility benefit

 - Wellhub Membership

 - Pliant Card with monthly credit to explore the product and enjoy food with colleagues


Pliant is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and abilities, and are committed to an inclusive hiring process. If you need any accommodations during the interview process, please let us know.


At Pliant we use the Ashby AI Criteria to assist with looking over resumes against our job qualifications for this role. All final decisions are made by our Talent Team and Hiring Team.

A human is behind these processes. Ashby does not automatically reject candidates or make final hiring decisions. Our teams review all results and make the final hiring decision with every candidate that applies.

title: Software Engineer, Backend (Trading)
description:
Phantom https://phantom.com is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.



Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Check out our Forbes Fintech 50 https://www.forbes.com/sites/ninabambysheva/2026/02/23/inside-phantoms-battle-plan-to-win-the-crypto-fueled-superapp-war/ and CNBC and Statista's World's Top Fintech Companies 2026 https://www.cnbc.com/worlds-top-fintech-companies-2026/! 



We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.




RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Software Engineer at Phantom, you’ll play a key role in building the systems that power our trading experiences. You’ll design and implement APIs, data pipelines, and services that bridge the gap between blockchain infrastructure and the seamless, intuitive experiences our users expect.

In this role, you’ll focus on the implementation and aggregation of new trading protocols, aggregators, and trade types, as well as experimenting with new trading surfaces and user segments. Your work will directly shape the future of how users discover, execute, and interact with digital asset trades across multiple ecosystems.

 - Feature development: You will be owning features on our web platforms – currently the Phantom Extension https://phantom.app/download and our website.

 - New initiatives and products: You will be leading initiatives to add support for other blockchains to Phantom, and to launch new complementary products or infrastructure.

 - Interfacing with users: You will be interfacing directly with end-users and developers building on Phantom – supporting them and collecting feedback to inform the direction of the product.

 - Team building: You will be working with the team to create and foster a culture of raising the bar with each new hire.
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience

 - 5+ years full-time software engineering experience

 - Demonstrated interest in open and community-driven platforms

 - Nice-To-Have: Experience working with trading systems

 - English language proficiency
   

The target base salary for this role will range between $200,000 to $250,000 with the addition of equity and benefits. This is determined by a few factors including your skillset, prior relevant experience, quality of interviews and market factors (such as location) at the point in time of offer.



Why Work With Us

Phantom's journey to becoming a global trading app began with making crypto easier to use. Today, we’re building on that foundation to help people discover the markets that matter, make informed financial moves, and safely store or spend their money worldwide. Joining Phantom means helping shape that next chapter: building products that bring the freedom of open markets to more people.

 

 - Build for global impact: Create products used by tens of millions of people, making innovative financial markets more accessible to users around the world.

 - Make complexity feel simple: Solve meaningful challenges across design, engineering, and user experience to make discovering markets and managing money seamless.

 - Put users in control: Help build a future where people have greater freedom over their assets and financial decisions, with security and self-custody at the foundation.



Benefits (only available to full-time employees)

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision): base plan 100% covered 

 - Flexible hours and a long-standing, supportive remote environment

 - Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

 - 401(k) retirement plan

 - Wellness stipend

 - Weekly meal stipend

 - Learning & Development stipend

 - Remote / WFH set-up stipend



We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career.



By submitting your resume and application materials, you acknowledge and agree that Phantom Technologies, Inc. ("Phantom") collects and processes your personal information (including application materials, interview records, and related data) to evaluate your candidacy. Phantom may use AI-powered tools and third-party service providers for transcription, note-taking, scheduling, and other administrative tasks. Phantom does not sell your information and your materials will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

title: Senior Data Engineer, LATAM
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a data infrastructure and analytics team building a platform that turns information from multiple sources into reliable, current company intelligence. You will own the platform end-to-end, from architecture and ingestion through production operations.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design a multi-source data platform for concurrent ingestion, event-driven processing, and orchestrated batch workflows.

 - Build intake pipelines for APIs, webhooks, files, and web scraping, with rate limits and robust failure handling.

 - Orchestrate scheduled workflows and historical backfills using tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect.

 - Develop messaging and task queue systems with retries, dead-letter queues, and controlled replay.

 - Preserve source payloads in Google Cloud Storage and transform data with dbt into raw, standardized, and curated layers.

 - Implement idempotent upserts, data contracts, automated validation, pipeline tests, and monitoring for freshness and failures.

 - Design and optimize PostgreSQL schemas and loading patterns, and integrate enrichment and LLM-based structured extraction.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 5 years building and operating production data platforms across multiple sources, with ownership from architecture through deployment and ongoing operations.

 - Hands-on production experience with dbt and Google Cloud Platform, and workflow orchestration using Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Temporal, or a comparable tool. Airflow is preferred.

 - Strong Python skills, including asynchronous HTTP and concurrent processing with asyncio, aiohttp, or HTTPX.

 - Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills, including data modeling, query optimization, and reliable incremental loading.

 - Experience building event-driven systems with messaging or task queues, asynchronous processing, and failure recovery.

 - Experience with data contracts, raw and curated storage, retention policies, automated testing, and production monitoring.

 - Helpful experience includes web scraping, entity resolution, company and people data enrichment, LLM-based extraction, and building platforms from scratch in small teams.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $80,000 to $120,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

Fully remote for candidates based in Latin America.

title: Senior Integrations Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a small engineering team building data-heavy distributed systems for a logistics technology platform serving temperature-controlled and high-value shipments. You will own partner-facing integrations and the data flows that help logistics teams understand shipment conditions and respond to risk.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and operate end-to-end partner data flows, from multi-vendor ingestion and normalization through warehousing, monitoring, and on-call support.

 - Build backend services and event-driven systems that ingest, process, and contextualize IoT sensor and shipment data.

 - Develop integrations with external partner APIs, webhooks, queues, carriers, sensors, and vendors.

 - Build data models, APIs, and workflows that support shipment risk assessment and exception handling.

 - Improve service reliability through testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.

 - Work independently as a senior individual contributor on a small integrations team.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 5 years of backend engineering experience, with around 6 to 10 years preferred, building scalable production systems.

 - Hands-on proficiency in Python and TypeScript or Node.js, plus SQL, relational data modeling, and experience with NoSQL databases and ETL pipelines.

 - Production ownership of external partner integrations and end-to-end data pipelines, including multi-vendor ingestion and configurable transformations.

 - Experience with IoT data, event-driven architectures, and messaging systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.

 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, and REST or gRPC APIs.

 - Strong software engineering practices, including testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.

 - Logistics, supply chain, cold-chain, shipment risk, or regulated healthcare data experience is valuable, as is familiarity with related security and privacy requirements.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is $140,000 to $180,000 annually, with equity and a cash bonus. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

Remote within the United States.

title: Engineering Manager [AI Platform]
description:
We are seeking a hands-on Engineering Manager for AI Platform , the team that builds and supports internal AI platforms used across the company.
You will lead a cross-functional engineering team, own delivery end to end, and work closely with Product, Data, and AI teams on scope, priorities, and the platform roadmap. This is a hands-on role: beyond people management, you will take an active part in shaping the architecture and making technical decisions within the team.
Challenges that await you:
• Build and lead the team across hiring, planning, task decomposition, process improvements, and cross-team collaboration
• Own and drive the development of internal AI platforms from concept to production, and keep them reliable as adoption grows
• Turn recurring needs from product teams into reusable platform capabilities rather than one-off solutions
• Ensure strong team performance and reliable, on-time delivery aligned with company and business goals
• Partner closely with Product, Data, and AI teams, and with the internal teams who use the platforms, to understand their needs and drive adoption

What makes you a great fit:

• Strong cross-team communication skills and the ability to collaborate with Product, Data and business stakeholders

Our ways of working:

Our benefits:

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Pricing Platform
description:
We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help build the core systems that price insurance for millions of customers. You'll join our Pricing Team in Amsterdam, where complex analytics meets high-performance engineering. You'll work alongside actuaries to turn their insights into code that scales, from our homegrown domain-specific language to AI-powered research pipelines.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.


IN THIS ROLE YOU'LL

 - Design and build core rating services that calculate prices for products used by millions

 - Architect systems across TypeScript, Rust, and Python, each solving a different kind of problem

 - Build AI-powered research pipelines that help actuaries discover new pricing patterns

 - Create SDKs and code patterns that other teams can build on

 - Optimize performance-critical systems where milliseconds shape the customer experience

 - Partner with actuaries to turn complex mathematical models into scalable code

 - Lead technical decisions on architecture, interfaces, and design patterns


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - 10+ years of experience building backend systems

 - Deep experience with system design and architectural decision-making, beyond API development

 - Strong proficiency in one backend language (TypeScript, Rust, or Python) and the ability to pick up the others quickly

 - A track record of designing complex systems from scratch, including the interfaces and abstractions

 - Experience building performance-optimized systems where technical choices directly affect business outcomes

 - A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

 - Ready to work in an office environment most days of the week

 - Nice to have:
   
   - Experience with ML and Data science pipelines.
   
   - Experience with vectorization frameworks like JAX.

title: Senior Product Engineer - Growth
locationText: Remote - North America - Europe | Remote - EU

description:
Who We Are:
Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.
Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.
Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.
Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.
Our Team Members:
We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!
We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.
Your Role:
As a Senior Product Engineer on the Acquisition team, you will build the tools and services that help developers launch applications on Alpaca. That covers everything from how accounts and identity are set up to the APIs and SDKs partners integrate with. You will work mostly in Go services, with some TypeScript and React.
You will help shape the plan as well as deliver it, and you will own the onboarding experience while dedicated teams support with domain expertise. Exciting challenges wait in central parts of the onboarding process, such as identity, accounts and payments. You will work closely with respective teams to design APIs, challenge existing assumptions, and ship together.
Things You Get To Do:
• Design and build APIs, SDKs, and Go services that let partners build experiences on Alpaca
• Own partner journeys from first sign-up through a working integration
• Contribute across teams' codebases on identity, accounts, payments, and onboarding, and collaborate with those teams on API design
• Turn ambiguous business goals into actionable plans, and help shape the roadmap for a new area
• Use data and partner feedback to understand where developers get stuck and what to build next
Who You Are (Must-Haves):
• 5+ years building production backend services and APIs in Go or another modern backend language
• Experience designing REST APIs, and strong SQL and relational database skills, preferably PostgreSQL
• Able to ship frontend work in TypeScript and React when needed
• Experience owning a customer or developer journey end to end, such as onboarding, sign-up, activation, or an integration, and able to speak to the business outcome, not just the code
• A track record of contributing to codebases owned by other teams and driving cross-team work to completion
• Experience with OAuth, OIDC, or similar authorization systems
Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):
• Experience building products for external developers, such as public APIs, SDKs, or developer documentation
• Experience with developer platforms, partner portals, or marketplaces
• Experience with multi-tenant account or identity models
• Experience in fintech, payments, identity verification (KYC), or other regulated industries
• Experience on a growth team or at an early-stage company, shipping whatever it takes to move an outcome
How We Take Care of You:
• Competitive Salary & Stock Options
• Health Benefits
• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card
Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.
